get.summary: Verify user email address using token

302.description: Redirects to frontend verification result page

200.description: Verification email sent if account is unverified

post.summary: Authenticate with email or username and password

200.description: Password reset link sent if account exists

410.description: Password reset link has expired or has already been used
Password reset link has expired or has already been used

400.description: Invalid current password or account has no local password

post.description: Creates a new enterprise profile. Authenticated recruiter or admin required. Default status is pending for recruiters and active for admins.

409.description: Conflict: Tax code or email already registered, or account already owns an enterprise

get.description: Public for Active enterprises. Administrators can filter by any status or query all enterprises.
Returns complete enterprise information. Non-active enterprises are accessible only to the owner or admins.

404.description: Enterprise not found or not accessible

patch.description: Updates company details. Accessible only by the enterprise owner (Recruiter) or a System Administrator.

403.description: Forbidden: not authorized to modify this enterprise profile

409.description: Conflict: Email or tax code already registered by another enterprise

delete.description: Soft-deletes an enterprise profile. Exclusive to System Administrator. Fails if the enterprise currently has published active jobs.

400.description: Cannot delete enterprise with active job postings

patch.description: Transitions enterprise status (pending, active, suspended, rejected, inactive). Exclusive to System Administrator. Justification reason mandatory for suspended and rejected statuses.

400.description: Invalid status transition or missing mandatory reason
